title: Rory and the Velvet Clover Knoll
verses:
The dusk settled softly across the green hill,
The breeze in the branches was quiet and still.
And Rory stepped slow on the velvet-clad ground,
Where sleepy sweet blossoms were scattered around.

Now Ricky chased shadows that danced in the grass,
Then stopped as he watched the pink twilight clouds pass.
High over the trees, Nia glided in flight,
To welcome the stars and the silvery night.

Tilly gathered fresh clover to make a deep bed,
A pillow of petals for each sleepy head.
While Benny leaned down with a hum low and deep,
To rock the whole meadow to comfort and sleep.

Then Psittaco chirped from a nest in the bark,
And watched as the shadows turned cozy and dark.
Then Rory lay down on the pillowy moss,
As ribbons of moonlight fell softly across.

The crickets played songs in the cool evening air,
With starlight and peace drifting down everywhere.
And Ricky let out a sweet, delicate yawn,
Contented to rest until break of the dawn.

Now Benny and Tilly were closing their eyes,
Beneath the pale glow of the slumbering skies.
And Nia and Psittaco dreamed on the crest,
While Rory was sinking in velvety rest.
